## About
Torino Trailers builds trailers for just about anything you need to haul. Horse, car, boat, jet ski, generator, utility, lawn, fork lift and heavy equipment trailers all come out of our shop, and if you need something different we can custom build it.
Beyond building trailers, we carry trailers and accessories and handle service too. You can find us at 5045 NW 79th Ave in Miami, open Monday through Saturday. Google reviewers rate us 4 stars across 244 reviews.

## Services
- Trailers for every need: Trailers for horses, cars, boats, jet skis, generators, lawn equipment, fork lifts, heavy equipment and general utility use.
- We build the trailer for it: Hauling something unusual? Tell us what needs to be pulled and we can build the trailer for it.
- Trailers and accessories: A large variety of trailers and accessories to choose from at our Miami shop.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of trailers do you build?
A: Horse, car, boat, jet ski, generator, utility, lawn, fork lift and heavy equipment trailers, plus whatever else needs to be pulled.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday mornings from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM. We are closed on Sunday.

Q: What are your weekday hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM.
